description: Hand-specified golden cases for the published catalogue tools, written from the contract text alone and never generated from an implementation. Unit 1b freezes the get_model exact-ID and marker-lookup cases against lookup.json (oracle case 1 scenario); later units append their own cases to 'cases'. The envelope-freeze correction froze the successful PURE get_model payload: the top-level field set (including provider_staleness), the endpoint field set and the counts cardinalities (exact_matches, endpoints, distinct_raw_ids, marker_group_labels) are final. Counts describe the returned lookup result only. The shared-ID correction gives the two providers tracking vendor/shared intentionally conflicting, valid per-provider metadata (synthetic-a: large text-only context; synthetic-b: image input with a smaller context) so that metadata attachment by (provider, raw model_id) is testable; every snapshot_id was recomputed from the lookup.json fixture body. Unit 1c-a appends four metadata edge-case goldens against metadata-edge-cases.json (unknown-context / known-context / zero-context / unknown-description, plus a stale zero-ID second provider), each with a complete literal payload whose snapshot_id is the real canonical hash of that fixture body. Unit 1c-b1 appends two capability goldens against capability-unknown.json (an all-null-capability model and a known-empty-lists model, plus a stale zero-ID second provider); the two ids are not free-marker variants, so each query returns exactly one endpoint, all four counts are 1, and both payloads preserve the null-versus-empty distinction. Unit 1c-b2 appends twenty-eight search_models goldens across four fixtures (metadata-edge-cases.json, capability-unknown.json, lookup.json and the new search-text.json): literal ASCII-folded substring search, provider-scoped staleness, minimum-context and capability-array AND filtering, a page crossing a provider boundary, exhausted and beyond-end pagination, and the frozen PAGE-scoped counts — each a complete literal payload whose snapshot_id is the real canonical hash of its fixture body. Unit 1c-c appends nine watchdog_status goldens: complete fixed-clock payloads (each with a case-level now epoch, never a tool argument) over capability-unknown.json, metadata-edge-cases.json, lookup.json and the new status-unknown-time.json (tick_epoch null) and status-short-cadence.json (cadence_s 120) — pinning the inclusive one-cadence freshness boundary, the tick_stale / tick_epoch_future / tick_epoch_unknown derivations, whole-catalogue counts, metadata coverage over the tracked-pair denominator, provider staleness independent of tick freshness, and the strictly-null unobservable fields.
